title: rules.version.published.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction where a second person approves a PENDING_APPROVAL version (POST .../versions/{v}:approve, DESIGN section 3.3). The version is PUBLISHED and takes effect at effectiveFrom; caches are invalidated after commit. The outbox row id is the event id. Additive changes only within v1.

version.description: Version number of the rule set, not the lock version.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

occurredAt.description: When the transition committed, ISO 8601 UTC.

canonicalHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical document, lower-case hex: the behaviour under four eyes (ADR-0026). effectiveFrom is not part of it.

effectiveFrom.description: The instant the version takes effect, ISO 8601 UTC: the requested date, or the approval instant when none was requested. Never null on this event.

approvedBy.description: Who approved it; always equal to actor, and never the requester or the author (four eyes).
